q.g: In this quest you first have to shoot a yellow flare into the sky while being inside the train area on Reserve or Lighthouse, depending on your faction. If the flare doesn't reach a certain height, the quest objective won't complete. You can use either the handheld RSP-30 yellow flare which can be bought at Prapor LL1 or a 26x75mm yellow flare cartridge which can be bought at Jaeger LL1, and is fired from a signal pistol. If you use the handheld RSP-30 yellow flare, make sure to aim it upwards, but not too much or it lands behind you. Afterwards you have to kill any 6 targets in the area in the same raid.
